class.name: SteamAchievementInfo
class.brief_description: Metadata for a single Steam achievement.
class.description: Returned by [method Steam.get_achievement_info] and [method Steam.get_all_achievements]. Includes localized display data and an optional [Image] icon converted from Steam RGBA image data.

method.name: get_api_name
method.description: Steamworks API name for the achievement.

method.name: get_icon
method.description: Achievement icon as an RGBA [Image], or [code]null[/code] if unavailable.

method.name: get_unlock_time
method.description: Unix timestamp when the achievement was unlocked, or [code]0[/code] if not unlocked or unknown.

method.name: is_achieved
method.description: Whether the local user has unlocked this achievement.

method.name: is_hidden
method.description: Whether the achievement is hidden in the Steam community UI until unlocked.
